title: Homesite Reservation Hold Period and Extension Allowances
content:
Hold term sheet for the Homesite Reservation. Every figure is set by the premium class of the reserved homesite.

| Premium class | Initial hold (calendar days from the reservation date) | Maximum extensions per reservation | Days added by one extension | Extension fee per extension (USD) | Extension fees credited to the lot premium on conversion | Extension requires a refreshed pre-qualification letter | Maximum total hold (calendar days from the reservation date to the latest hold expiry date extensions may produce) | Courtesy expiry reminder (calendar days before the hold expiry date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Interior Homesite | 14 | 2 | 7 | 0.00 | Yes | No | 28 | 3 |
| Corner Homesite | 14 | 2 | 7 | 0.00 | Yes | No | 28 | 3 |
| Cul-de-Sac Homesite | 10 | 1 | 7 | 250.00 | Yes | No | 17 | 3 |
| Greenbelt Homesite | 10 | 1 | 7 | 500.00 | Yes | Yes | 17 | 2 |
| Water-View Homesite | 7 | 1 | 5 | 750.00 | No | Yes | 12 | 2 |
| Golf-Frontage Homesite | 7 | 0 | 5 | 1000.00 | No | Yes | 7 | 2 |

## Notes

- **Initial hold days** are the calendar days the homesite is held, counted from the reservation date.
- **Extension days** are the calendar days one extension adds to the current hold expiry date.
- **Extension fee credited.** "Yes" means paid extension fees are credited to the lot premium on conversion; "No" means they are retained by Calloway.
- **Refreshed letter.** "Yes" means an extension requires a pre-qualification letter no older, on the extension date, than the class's maximum letter age.
- **Maximum total hold** caps the calendar days from the reservation date to the latest hold expiry date that extensions may produce.
- A class whose maximum extensions figure is 0 (Golf-Frontage Homesite) has no extensions available.
